NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author said the PR was updated, but there is no new push: the head commit is unchanged since the feedback. The description still has the same hard-to-read screenshot sets.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | The screenshots still don't follow the precise before/after guide: each test has several loosely captioned images, and it's unclear what changed between them. |
| ❌  | The description's own Test 2 (collapse, then mute) says the bug still happens after the fix, so the behavior isn't fully working. |
| ❌  | The checklist says automated tests verify the logic, but only `condense.ts` and `message_list_view.ts` changed, so no tests were added. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer yet; ask the author to push a fix and redo the screenshots.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update, @FAzabmpc! I don't see a new push since the feedback, and the screenshots still don't follow the [precise before/after guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots). Your Test 2 also says the collapse-then-mute case still fails, so please fix that (and add tests, or correct the checklist) before we review.
```
